books.title: Trembling, Still: The Awful Clarity of a Mind in Eclipse
books.author: Stephen Jenkinson
books.description: A journal kept from the day of his Parkinson's diagnosis in January 2024 to an epilogue in July 2025. The former palliative-care director who wrote Die Wise turns his attention to his own decline, writing about fear, grief, awe and what the soul is asked to do when illness arrives.
